Location: Remote, Latin America. Overlap with Europe/Amsterdam hours required.
Type: Full-time independent contractor, paid in USD. Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,500 per month, depending on experience.

Turn Fabian’s voice notes, calls and client results into posts, threads and videos.
- Write and package case studies with client approval.
- Produce AI-assisted images and short video (Nano Banana 2 or equivalent, UGC-style and explainer clips).
- Edit and package YouTube long-form and cut Shorts.
- Build automations in n8n, Notion and Slack for capture, drafting, scheduling and reporting.
- Reply to comments and DMs, and flag warm leads to Fabian the same day.
- Send a one-page weekly report: what shipped, what worked, what changes next.
You are a fit if you:
Have a portfolio of AI video or UGC-style work you can link to.
- Write clear English and have written for a founder or B2B brand with results you can state in numbers.
- Use AI tools every day and have built at least one automation (n8n, Make or Zapier).
- Can edit video and make thumbnails.
- Work async, hit deadlines and tell us early when something is off.
- Can overlap at least 3 hours with Europe/Amsterdam hours on two days a week, and at least 2 hours on other days.
Nice to have:
n8n or Claude Code experience
- SEO, link building or ecommerce knowledge
- Agency or founder personal-brand experience
- YouTube growth experience
- Spanish or Portuguese
What success looks like in 90 days:
Voice guide, content system and baseline report done by day 30.
- 90% of planned posts shipped on time by day 60.
- 8 or more case study assets and 8 or more long-form videos published by day 90.
- Qualified inbound conversations from social, tracked from day 1.
Rules we care about: No fake testimonials, no fake clients on video, no unverified results claims. Client approval before any case study goes live.
How to apply: Apply here (includes a short Loom video): Answer 3 short questions, including links to your AI video or UGC work. We read every application with a scorecard. Strong candidates may be offered a short paid work sample (about 2 hours). We reply to every complete application within 7 days.
EcomSEO and Akravo are equal opportunity. We hire on the work you can show.

gigs.title: Lean Marketing: Marketing Coordinator - 2HourGlass
gigs.body:
About 2hourglass
2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania. Our technicians go to the customer's home or business and fix broken glass, foggy (failed-seal) glass and window hardware on site, often the same or next day. About 80% of our work is residential and 20% commercial.
Our promise is in the name: speed and certainty. Customers send a photo, get a price, and we fix the one window they need. We don't push them to replace five. That approach has earned us roughly 1,300 five-star Google reviews.
Our biggest opportunity is the homeowners who don't know their window can be repaired at all, so they live with it. Our new website is live. Over the next 6–12 months we're improving its conversion, sharpening our Google and Facebook ads, and launching email and SMS follow-up. Over the next 2–3 years we want a marketing machine that runs without depending on the founder. This role is the first step toward that.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a results-driven, hands-on person to join our team. The role is remote, part-time, and headquartered in Pennsylvania (US Eastern time).The role
As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll plan, coordinate and carry out our marketing across the website, Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, email, SMS and reviews. You'll be our first and only in-house marketing person.
You'll work directly with the founder. He sets the strategy and big-picture goals; you own the day-to-day execution and keep projects moving. We also work with an outside marketing coach, so you'll have a clear plan and support.
Hours
Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow toward full-time
Location
Remote; overlap with US Eastern business hours required
Reports to
Founder
Pay
[$25–35/hour] depending on experience
You'll need to organize, plan and structure your own workload. We don't have the time or the inclination to micromanage. You'll get a lot of freedom and a lot of responsibility.What you'll do
Website performance and metrics (top priority). Our new website is live. Track how it and our Google Ads landing pages perform (traffic, bounce rate, calls and quote requests) and make the adjustments the numbers call for: copy, offers, reviews and calls to action. Keep each county and service page current and working.
Paid ads coordination. Support our Google Ads (people ready to book now) and Facebook/Meta ads (people who don't know repair is possible). Brief and manage ad creative, and work with any outside agency or freelancer.
Content and social media. Plan and run a content calendar that teaches homeowners their broken, foggy or sticking windows can be repaired. Create, schedule and post content, reply to comments, and repurpose content across channels.
Copywriting. Write and edit copy for the website, ads, emails, SMS and social posts in a clear, friendly, local-business voice.
Email, SMS and CRM. Build and manage welcome, follow-up and reactivation campaigns in our CRM (Close). Re-engage stalled leads and past customers.
Reviews and social proof. Turn our ~1,300 five-star Google reviews into marketing assets. Keep our Google Business Profile active and fresh.
Offers and referrals. Help launch and promote a low-cost entry offer and simple referral and repeat-customer programs.
Tracking and reporting. Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard: leads by source, cost per lead and per job, landing-page performance and ad return. Flag what's working and what isn't.
Project management. Create and keep project timelines, manage freelancers and vendors, and make sure campaigns ship on time.
Coordination with the team. Work with the founder and office team so marketing, lead follow-up and scheduling stay aligned.
Your first 90 days
By day 90, we should see clearly which marketing produces booked jobs, and the website should be converting better than at your start.
Timeframe
What success looks like
Days 1–30
You know our services, customers, brand and tools (Close CRM, website, ad accounts). Our weekly marketing dashboard is up to date. Stalled leads from Facebook have been followed up.
Days 31–60
You've set a baseline for website and landing-page conversion and made a first round of data-driven adjustments, such as stronger use of our reviews and the "send a photo, get a price" offer. A content calendar is running on Facebook.
Days 61–90
Website and landing-page conversion has improved against the day-30 baseline. Welcome and reactivation email/SMS sequences are live. The entry offer and a referral program are launched. You present a monthly results report to the founder.
What we're looking forThe six non-negotiables
Copywriting. You'll write for the web, ads, email, SMS and social media. Your writing must be excellent, and we'll ask for samples.
Tech-savvy. You don't need to be a technical expert, but you pick up new tools fast: CRMs, website builders, ad platforms, email tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
Project management. You set deadlines, keep them, and move several projects forward at once.
Self-starter. Goals will be clear. Often it'll be up to you to decide what needs to happen, when and how, and then do it without being chased.
Teachable and coachable. We do marketing differently, and there's a lot to learn on the job. We hire mainly on attitude.
Leadership potential. You'll start as our only marketer. As you hit goals, we expect this role to grow into leading a small marketing team.
Nice to have
Experience marketing a local or home-services business (trades, cleaning, HVAC, roofing, real estate)
Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or Google Business Profile
Experience with Close or a similar CRM, and with email/SMS automations
Basic design skills (Canva or similar) and basic video editing
Comfort with dashboards and numbers (Looker Studio, Airtable, Google Sheets)
Perks of the job
Fully remote, with flexible hours you set around US Eastern business hours
Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow to full-time
Real ownership: your work goes live fast and you'll see its impact on booked jobs
Hands-on marketing and management experience, with coaching from an experienced marketing team
Pay: [$25–35/hour depending on experience]

Own ticket volume, response time, and time-to-resolution metrics as the primary Tier 1 support owner, finding and implementing automation solutions

Track and report on volume, response time, and resolution time for this channel

Maintain and continuously improve the frontline FAQ/knowledge base
Document standard operating procedures for common ticket types and troubleshooting flows
Flag recurring or emerging issues that indicate a need for broader process or product changes
App Store Monitoring
Actively monitor app store ratings and reviews per agreed-upon protocols, and respond to members and customers as appropriate
Surface trends and actionable insights to Product, Operations, and Leadership
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Operations to align support processes with broader program delivery
Work with Product and Tech to report bugs, prioritize fixes, and pilot new features from a support-operations lens
Collaborate with Public Health and Operations teams to ensure member support practices align with clinical and program protocols
Qualifications
3-5 years of experience in customer/member technical support, SaaS user support, or service operations, ideally in healthcare or health tech
Fluent bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English (spoken and written)
Good listening and communication skills- Able to identify root causes and prevent escalation by confirming issues, empathizing with individuals, and working toward a positive outcome. These strengths are essential for de-escalating frustration, as you turn routine interactions into opportunities for customer loyalty rather than conflict
Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex or escalated issues with minimal oversight
Hands-on experience with a ticketing platform
Strong cross-functional communication skills — comfortable working with Product, Tech, Operations, and Public Health stakeholders
Comfort building basic reporting/metrics and communicating trends to leadership
Startup mentality: adaptable, resourceful, and willing to do both strategic and tactical work
Growth mindset — interest in eventually building and leading a team as the function scales
Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in a startup or health tech company.
Experience partnering with hospitals, health plans, or public health organizations on quality improvement initiatives.

If you are a compassionate, tech-savvy healthcare professional with a passion for patient engagement and medication adherence, we want to hear from you! Apply today to join us in transforming healthcare and empowering patients toward better health outcomes.

Win rate against named primary competitors
Competitive displacement, meaning deals won where an incumbent competitor was in seat
Deal velocity and influenced ACV in competitive opportunities
Field adoption of competitive assets, measured rather than assumed

Take ownership and evolve our existing program impact measurement capabilities, built in-house and in partnership with third-party experts such as IQVIA.
Develop and maintain  analytically rigorous program performance benchmarks.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team
As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.
Collaboration—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.
Passion for Data—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.
Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

10+ years of professional experience in a quantitative or statistical role (e.g., statistician, biostatistician), within healthcare, pharma, or a related industry.

Experience representing yourself externally and leading client conversations around program performance analysis.

We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.
Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.
The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

Base salary
Equity (where applicable)
Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Flexible paid time off and company holidays
Paid parental leave
Professional development and learning opportunities

Why You'll Love Working Here
At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.
Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
